simulator.no_behavior_msg: Press {{count}}× has no behavior defined — open the editor to add one

editor.reset_confirm: Reset all behaviors? This cannot be undone.
editor.load_sample_tooltip: Loads a starter program transcribed from the kid's class photo (Scribbler Program Maker). Verify the values before competition.
editor.load_sample_confirm: Load the sample program? This replaces the programs on ALL press buttons.
editor.out_of_grade_notice: This program uses blocks that are hidden in the current grade. It still runs — switch grade to see and edit those blocks.
editor.empty_banner: No behaviors configured yet. Load the kid's class program to start.
editor.instructions_with_blocks: Drag blocks to define what the robot does when you press reset {{count}}×. Currently: {{blocks}} block(s).
editor.instructions_empty: Drag blocks to define what the robot does when you press reset {{count}}×. Empty — nothing will happen until you add blocks.

blocks.drive_distance_tooltip: Drive forward (positive) or backward (negative) by N centimetres
blocks.drive_wheels_tooltip: Set left and right wheel speeds independently (-100..100), run for N ms. Equal speeds drive straight; opposite speeds spin in place.
blocks.drive_arc_tooltip: Drive along a curved arc. Positive degrees turn right, negative turn left. Radius 0 is in-place spin.
blocks.follow_line_tooltip: Follow the black line smoothly using the analog line sensors (0-100 reflectivity, like the real S3). Steering is proportional — stronger correction the further the line drifts.
blocks.rotate_degrees_tooltip: Rotate right (positive) or left (negative) by N degrees
blocks.beep_tooltip: Play a beep for N milliseconds
blocks.repeat_tooltip: Repeat the inner blocks N times
blocks.if_tooltip: Run different blocks depending on a sensor reading
blocks.while_tooltip: Repeat blocks while a sensor reads TRUE
blocks.while_not_tooltip: Repeat blocks until a sensor reads TRUE (e.g. follow a line)

challenges.list_hint: Finish a mission to earn a star. Do it efficiently — fewer presses or faster — for two and three stars!
challenges.g4_first_drive_desc: Get from A to B on the open board. 3 stars: 7 presses or fewer.
challenges.g4_bonus_hunter_desc: Reach B AND collect the ⭐ on the way. 3 stars: 8 presses or fewer.
challenges.g4_maze_runner_desc: Escape the maze. 3 stars: 20 presses or fewer.
challenges.g4_junction_drill_desc: Stop at the 🛑, then drive RIGHT, STRAIGHT, RIGHT through the junctions — the 📍 checkpoints check your route. 3 stars: 9 presses or fewer.
challenges.g5_diagonal_path_desc: Cross the diagonal board using 45° turns. 3 stars: 10 presses or fewer.
challenges.g5_speedrun_desc: Same board, against the clock. 3 stars: under 60 seconds.
challenges.g79_racing_desc: Follow the line to the finish. 3 stars: under 45 seconds — try the smooth follower!
challenges.g79_one_press_desc: Finish the race with a SINGLE button press. 3 stars: also under 45 seconds.
